reports.title: Royal Gold Reports Strong Third Quarter Results, Including Record Operating Cash Flow and Gold Equivalent Ounce Sales, Additional Share Repurchases and Full Repayment of Debt after Quarter End

guidance.heading: Outlook for 2026
section: Royal Gold provided guidance for 2026 metal sales, depreciation, depletion and amortization ("DD&A") expense and effective tax rate in March 2026. Based on strong year-to-date sales, we are raising our full-year sales guidance for other metals and expect to be at or exceed the top end of our guidance ranges for silver and copper. We continue to expect gold sales, DD&A expense and the effective tax rate to be within the original ranges. The table below shows the original and revised guidance ranges, along with actual results through September 30, 2026.
